variants.text: Adult woman with oval face, almond-shaped eyes, straight nose, and long reddish-brown hair.
Adult woman with an oval face, prominent cheekbones, almond-shaped eyes, and a straight nose, wearing a linked metal necklace and featuring long reddish-brown hair.

Adult woman with an oval face, prominent cheekbones, and moderate forehead with a straight hairline. Medium-thickness soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with upward canthal tilt, and double eyelid creases. Straight nose, moderate vermilion fullness in the mouth, and a defined jawline with a rounded chin. Hair is long and reddish-brown; wearing a linked metal necklace.
A woman with a nice oval face, long reddish-brown hair, and almond-shaped eyes. She has a bright smile, a clear complexion, and she is wearing a linked metal necklace.
